inference_configuration.system_prompt: redteam/tau2_airline/system-prompt.txt, then reference_bot_settings.SHARED_RULES (no opening rule: the greeting is already in the history), then the call-so-far note

session.tools: the 14 airline tools (redteam/tau2_airline/tool-definitions.json), as function definitions

history: the call so far, oldest first, appended to the system prompt as a note ('The call so far, oldest first. Carry on from here:'), since the service takes no history
turn: its voice activity detector (390 ms of silence ends a turn); the caller's line streamed at 16000 Hz
reply: its transcript of what it said
greeting: Hi! How can I help you today? (redteam/tau2_airline/first-message.txt)
caller_audio: the caller's newest line as audio: OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts, voice 'alloy', PCM16 at 24000 Hz; earlier kept turns go in as history, never as audio
session_per_caller_turn: a new session each caller turn; a tool call and its result stay in that turn's session
